findings.evidence: This commit adds `mysql.CreateTMPTablePriv` to `globalDBVisible` in `pkg/privilege/privileges/cache.go`, making `DBIsVisible()` return true for users granted only global `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES`. In `pkg/executor/show.go`, `fetchShowTableStatus()` gates on `DBIsVisible()` and then filters rows with `checker.RequestVerification(..., mysql.AllPrivMask)`, which (per `pkg/parser/mysql/privs.go` `AllPrivMask = AllPriv-1`) includes `CreateTMPTablePriv`. `RequestVerification()` in `pkg/privilege/privileges/cache.go` returns true as soon as `userPriv&priv>0`, so the global `CreateTMPTablePriv` bit satisfies `AllPrivMask` and all base-table rows pass the filter. `fetchShowIndex()` has the same `mysql.AllPrivMask` check and will also treat `CreateTMPTablePriv` as sufficient.
findings.fix: Use the same masking rule as `SHOW TABLES`: replace `mysql.AllPrivMask` with `mysql.AllPrivMask & (^mysql.CreateTMPTablePriv)` (or idiomatic `mysql.AllPrivMask &^ mysql.CreateTMPTablePriv`) in `pkg/executor/show.go` for `fetchShowTableStatus()` and `fetchShowIndex()` (and any other SHOW metadata paths intended to mean “any *real table* privilege”). Consider factoring a helper like `mysql.AllPrivMaskWithoutCreateTmp` to prevent drift.
findings.impact: Privilege/visibility leak: a user with only `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES` (especially granted globally, newly made DB-visible by this commit) can enumerate base-table metadata via `SHOW TABLE STATUS` (table names, row counts, comments, etc.), and can also access index metadata via `SHOW INDEX`, despite the intent elsewhere in this PR to stop `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES` from granting visibility into normal tables.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master`: `pkg/executor/show.go` still uses `mysql.AllPrivMask` in `fetchShowTableStatus()` and `fetchShowIndex()` (no masking-out of `CreateTMPTablePriv`).
findings.verify: Add coverage for the global-grant case: create a user with only `GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES ON *.*` (and separately `ON db.*`), then assert `SHOW TABLE STATUS FROM <db>` returns no base-table rows and `SHOW INDEX FROM <db>.<known_table>` is denied (or returns no rows). Also assert the intended behavior still holds: `SHOW DATABASES` includes DBs where the user has `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES`, and `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE db.t(...)` succeeds.
findings.what: After this commit, global `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES` makes databases visible (`globalDBVisible`), but `SHOW TABLE STATUS` (and `SHOW INDEX`) still use `mysql.AllPrivMask` for per-table filtering, so `CreateTMPTablePriv` is treated as sufficient and leaks base-table/index metadata to users who only have `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES`.

subject: privilege: fix `create temporary tables` privileges related bugs (#60313)
summary: The commit correctly prevents `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES` from satisfying the “any privilege” checks for `SHOW TABLES` and `SHOW CREATE TABLE` on normal tables, and makes DB visibility consistent for `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES` grants. However, the same masking is not applied to `SHOW TABLE STATUS` / `SHOW INDEX`, and the newly-expanded DB visibility for global `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES` makes `SHOW TABLE STATUS` an easy metadata-leak path.
